meta.subject: Fix issue #137: Kernel no longer runs user space programs

en.summary: The ITLB request mux used the wrong selector, so fetch lookups and maintenance/invalidate requests could source the wrong virtual page and ASID inputs. The fix restores selection based on whether the cache/fetch path is active.
why_it_counts: The patch changes instruction-side TLB request selection in core RTL.
The commit message describes a concrete regression affecting user-program execution.
The diff flips the mux guard and swaps the associated request_vpage_idx and request_asid sources.
evidence: The only modified DUT file is hardware/core/ifetch_tag_stage.sv.
The pre-fix code selected maintenance request inputs when dt_update_itlb_en was true and selected fetch inputs otherwise.

The fix changes the guard to cache_fetch_en so fetch lookups use pc_to_fetch and cr_current_asid[selected_thread_idx], while non-fetch maintenance operations use dt_update_itlb_vpage_idx and dt_update_itlb_asid.
The commit message explicitly says the comparison sense was inverted during refactoring and notes instruction-cache invalidates as an obvious failure case.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: The bug is a request-source mux selection error at the instruction-side TLB front end. A TLB structure often services both normal fetch lookups and maintenance operations such as insert or invalidate. The chosen source must depend on which kind of request is active. The broken behavior uses the wrong predicate, so maintenance operations can accidentally reuse fetch addresses or fetch lookups can consume maintenance metadata.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The TLB input path multiplexes between normal fetch traffic and maintenance or invalidate traffic, especially when invalidate requests do not assert the same update flag as inserts.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Invert or otherwise misuse the selector that chooses between fetch request fields and maintenance request fields.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: invert mux guard between normal lookup and maintenance path
portability_notes: Apply this where one TLB or cache front end reuses a request port for both lookups and software-visible maintenance operations.
The exact control signal names do not matter; the portable bug is selecting based on the wrong notion of “active request type.”
A high-value trigger is any invalidate operation that should use maintenance inputs but does not assert the same enable bit as a full update.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the mux that feeds virtual page and context fields into the instruction-side TLB or tag-lookup structure.
Change its guard so the fetch path is selected when maintenance inputs should be selected, or vice versa.
Leave the downstream TLB logic unchanged so the failure manifests as stale invalidation or wrong translation rather than a structural TLB fault.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: request_vpage_idx and request_asid mux ahead of the ITLB instance
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes the guard from dt_update_itlb_en to cache_fetch_en and swaps the fetch versus maintenance assignments accordingly.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the TLB inputs always_comb block, restore the old guard on dt_update_itlb_en and swap request_vpage_idx/request_asid sources back to the inverted arrangement.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Instruction fetches or TLB maintenance operations use the wrong address/context inputs, causing stale instruction translations, failed invalidates, or inability to load and run user programs correctly.
evidence_for_injection: The old code chose request inputs based on dt_update_itlb_en, which the commit message says was the wrong sense of the check.
The fixed code uses cache_fetch_en, matching the actual distinction between a fetch lookup and a non-fetch maintenance request.
The author specifically calls out instruction-cache invalidates as a case broken by the old logic.
notes: This is a portable mux-selection bug that fits many TLB and cache-maintenance designs.
If a DUT has a separate invalidate path instead of a unified TLB port, inject the same failure by misrouting invalidate metadata to the normal fetch-source path.

zh.summary: ITLB 请求复用器使用了错误的选择条件，导致正常取指查表和维护/失效请求可能会使用错误的虚拟页号与 ASID 输入。修复把选择条件恢复为“当前是否是 cache/fetch 路径”。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是核心 RTL 中指令侧 TLB 请求选择逻辑。
提交信息描述了一个会影响用户程序运行的明确回归。
差分翻转了 mux 条件，并交换了 request_vpage_idx 与 request_asid 的两组来源。
evidence: 唯一被修改的 DUT 文件是 hardware/core/ifetch_tag_stage.sv。
修复前代码在 dt_update_itlb_en 为真时选择维护请求输入，否则选择取指输入。
修复把条件改成 cache_fetch_en，因此取指查表使用 pc_to_fetch 和 cr_current_asid[selected_thread_idx]，而非取指维护操作使用 dt_update_itlb_vpage_idx 和 dt_update_itlb_asid。
提交信息明确说明该比较方向在重构时被写反，并指出指令 cache invalidate 是一个明显会出错的场景。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该错误属于指令侧 TLB 前端的请求源复用选择错误。一个 TLB 结构通常既要服务正常取指查表，也要服务插入、失效等维护操作。输入源必须根据当前真正活动的请求类型来选择。错误实现使用了错误的谓词，因此维护操作会误用取指地址，或者取指查表会误用维护元数据。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 指令侧 TLB 请求源选择
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: TLB 输入路径需要在正常取指流量和维护/失效流量之间复用，尤其是当 invalidate 请求不会像 insert 那样拉高 update 标志时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 翻转或错误使用在取指请求字段与维护请求字段之间进行选择的控制条件。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 翻转正常查找路径与维护路径之间的 mux 守卫条件
portability_notes: 将该变异应用到任何“一个 TLB 或 cache 前端复用单个请求端口同时处理查表和软件可见维护操作”的设计。
具体控制信号名并不重要；可移植的错误本质是按错误的“请求类型活动条件”进行选择。
高价值触发条件是：某类 invalidate 操作应使用维护输入，但不会拉高完整更新操作使用的 enable 位。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到把虚拟页号和上下文字段送入指令侧 TLB 或 tag lookup 结构的 mux。
修改其选择条件，使本应选择维护输入时却选择取指输入，或反之。
保持下游 TLB 逻辑不变，使故障表现为失效失效、翻译错误，而不是结构性 TLB 故障。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: ITLB 实例前的 request_vpage_idx 与 request_asid 复用逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把守卫条件从 dt_update_itlb_en 改为 cache_fetch_en，并相应交换了取指和维护两组赋值。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 TLB inputs 的 always_comb 代码块中，恢复旧的 dt_update_itlb_en 条件，并把 request_vpage_idx/request_asid 的两组来源换回错误排列。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 取指或 TLB 维护操作会使用错误的地址/上下文输入，导致指令翻译陈旧、invalidate 失效，或者用户程序无法被正确加载和运行。
evidence_for_injection: 旧代码按 dt_update_itlb_en 选择请求输入，而提交信息说明这正是“判断方向错误”的根源。
修复后代码改为使用 cache_fetch_en，与“当前是取指查表还是非取指维护请求”的真实区分一致。
作者特别指出 instruction-cache invalidate 是旧逻辑下会出错的场景。
notes: 这是高度可移植的 mux 选择类错误，适用于很多 TLB 与 cache 维护设计。
如果 DUT 为 invalidate 提供独立路径而非统一 TLB 端口，可以通过把 invalidate 元数据错误地路由到正常取指源来注入同类故障。
